job_description: Program Background: Friends In Village Development Bangladesh (FIVDB), through its Integrated Financial Services Program (IFSP), serves over 71,399 group members across 31 branches in the Sylhet Division. Building on the proven success of the `Nirmol Shakti Loan` and Solar Home System (SHS) initiatives, FIVDB is scaling up renewable energy access by launching the Domestic Rooftop Solar (DRS) Program in partnership with the Infrastructure Development Company Limited (IDCOL). The DRS Program aims to deploy 4,463 small- and medium-sized household and commercial rooftop solar systems (totaling 15.85 MWp capacity) across 35 upazilas in Sylhet, Moulvibazar, Sunamganj, and Habiganj districts. The program combines affordable micro-finance/enterprise credit mechanisms with end-to-end technical installation, net-metering facilitation, and after-sales maintenance services. This is a full-time, project-based contractual position. Major Duties and Responsibilities: 1. Program Management: Support, lead and manage the overall operationalization and strategic execution of the Domestic Rooftop Solar (DRS) Program across 31 IFSP branches in 35 upazilas of Sylhet, Moulvibazar, Sunamganj, and Habiganj. Ensure timely achievement of monthly and cumulative installation targets (4,463 systems / 15.85 MWp) and financial disbursement milestones in accordance with the approved Business Plan. Develop annual and quarterly operational work plans, deployment calendars, and resource allocation schedules across district and branch offices. Identify market opportunities, household demand patterns, and commercial rooftop prospects to scale adoption among rural and semi-urban communities. 2. Vendor, and Institutional Liaison: Act as the primary focal point and maintain regular operational and compliance liaison with FIVDB and IDCOL, ensuring strict adherence to the technical standards, refinancing protocols, and reporting timelines. Coordinate with approved solar equipment suppliers and service partners (such as Rahimafrooz Renewable Energy Ltd.) regarding procurement, warranty fulfillment, technical training, and installation support. Liaise with local power development authorities (BPDB, BREB/Palli Bidyut) at the regional level to streamline net-metering approvals and grid-integration procedures. 3. Financial Management, Credit Integration, and Inventory Oversight: Collaborate closely with IFSP central and branch accounts teams to synchronize solar credit disbursement, household down-payment collection, installment recovery, and IDCOL refinancing/mobilization advance claims. Monitor branch-level portfolio quality and coordinate with IFSP Branch Managers to address overdue installments or credit recovery challenges according to FIVDB policy. Oversee supply chain logistics, warehouse management, and inventory tracking across central and branch storage facilities so solar panels, inverters, batteries, and accessories are available ahead of demand. 4. Technical Quality Assurance and Team Supervision: Directly supervise, mentor, and evaluate district-based Technical Specialists and oversee the field performance of Program Assistants. Establish standard operating procedures (SOPs) for site feasibility, installation quality checks, customer orientation, complaint resolution, and preventive maintenance. Ensure occupational health and safety (OHS) protocols and rooftop working safety guidelines are strictly enforced across all installation sites. 5. Monitoring, Reporting, and Safeguarding Compliance: Maintain a centralized program MIS/database tracking system installations, capacity (kWp/MWp), branch-wise sales, credit status, net-metering progress, and warranty claims. Uphold FIVDB policies on safeguarding, PSEA, gender equality (recognizing that over 97% of IFSP group members are women), anti-fraud, and accountability.

job_description: The duration of the job will be until March, 2027. Key Duties & Responsibilities: Lead and coordinate the overall implementation of impact assessment research activities in Cox`s Bazar, ensuring compliance with the approved research methodology, work plan, and project objectives. Develop fieldwork plans, allocate responsibilities, and supervise research teams to ensure the timely and effective implementation of research activities in Cox’s Bazar, refugee camps and host communities. Supervise, guide, and monitor field supervisors, enumerators, and data collectors to ensure standardized, ethical, and high-quality data collection. Oversee impact assessment survey including household surveys, Key Informant Interviews (KIIs), In-depth interviews (IDIs), Focus Group Discussions (FGDs), and other relevant qualitative and quantitative data collection. Organize and facilitate training for enumerators and field supervisors on research tools, data collection techniques, research ethics, cultural sensitivity, and humanitarian field protocols. Ensure effective engagement with Rohingya communities and host populations through culturally appropriate communication and participatory research approaches. Coordinate with relevant humanitarian agencies, NGOs, government authorities, camp administration, CiC offices, and other stakeholders to facilitate field-level research activities. Ensure that all research activities follow appropriate humanitarian principles, safeguarding standards, protection protocols, informed consent procedures, and confidentiality requirements. Monitor field-level data collection through regular field visits, spot checks, back-checks, and real-time data monitoring to ensure data quality and adherence to research protocols. Oversee the use of digital data collection platforms such as KoboToolbox, ODK, and SurveyCTO, ensuring proper implementation and troubleshooting of field-level data collection processes. Coordinate data management, cleaning, validation, and preliminary analysis using relevant statistical software as Stata/ SPSS/ R/ Microsoft Excel. Identify and address field-level challenges, security concerns, access restrictions, and operational risks, ensuring appropriate adjustments to fieldwork strategies. Maintain effective coordination with local authorities, community leaders, Majhis, humanitarian actors, and other relevant stakeholders to ensure smooth field operations. Ensure gender-sensitive, age-inclusive, disability-inclusive, and culturally appropriate approaches throughout the research process, particularly when engaging women, children, persons with disabilities, and other vulnerable groups. Prepare regular field progress reports, data quality reports, monitoring updates, and other research documentation for project management and relevant stakeholders. Contribute to the interpretation of research findings, assessing project relevance, effectiveness, efficiency, sustainability, and impact on targeted populations. Lead the preparation, review, and finalization of research reports, ensuring accurate presentation of findings, data interpretation, evidence-based conclusions, and actionable recommendations. Manage team performance, monitor field-level deliverables, and ensure accountability, discipline, and professional conduct among research personnel. Perform any other research-related responsibilities assigned by the project senior management to ensure the successful completion of the project. Maintain regular communication and coordination with NGOF senior management for effective project implementation. Ensure the safety of team members from any harm, abuse, neglect, harassment, and exploitation to achieve the program’s goals of safeguarding implementation. Act as a key source of support, guidance, and expertise on safeguarding for establishing a safe working environment. Practice, promote and endorse the issues of safeguarding policy among team members and ensure the implementation of safeguarding standards in every course of action. Follow the safeguarding reporting procedure in case any reportable incident takes place and encourage others to do so.

Ensure timely arrangement of raw materials, packaging materials and other production-related materials to support the approved production schedule. Work closely with Production, Planning, Procurement and Warehouse teams to identify material shortages and resolve supply-related issues. Monitor material consumption, production requirements and replenishment plans. Ensure effective coordination between production schedules and procurement lead times. B. Project Procurement Manage procurement activities for new projects, factory expansion, machinery, equipment, utilities and other project-related requirements. Identify potential suppliers, collect quotations, evaluate proposals and negotiate competitive commercial terms. Coordinate technical and commercial evaluations with relevant departments. Ensure timely procurement and delivery of project materials, machinery and equipment. Monitor project procurement budgets, delivery schedules and supplier performance. Maintain proper procurement documentation and ensure compliance with company policies.   C. Coordinate with relevant departments to resolve contractual issues and manage variations or amendments. Maintain an organized contract database and ensure proper documentation and record keeping. D. Commercial Operations – Import & Export Manage overall commercial activities related to import and export operations. Handle LC opening, amendment, documentation, negotiation and settlement in coordination with banks. Coordinate with suppliers, banks, C&F agents, shipping lines, freight forwarders and relevant regulatory authorities. Monitor shipment schedules, customs clearance, port operations and timely delivery of imported materials. Ensure proper preparation and verification of PI, LC, commercial invoice, packing list, bill of lading, insurance and other relevant documents. Ensure compliance with applicable import-export regulations, customs procedures and company policies. Monitor freight charges, customs expenses, bank charges and other commercial costs to identify cost-saving opportunities. Maintain accurate commercial records for audit and management reporting. E. Material Control & Inventory Management Prepare and monitor material requirements in coordination with Production, Planning, Procurement and Warehouse departments. Ensure timely availability of raw materials, packaging materials, spare parts and other operational materials. Monitor stock levels, safety stock, reorder points, slow-moving and non-moving inventory. Maintain an effective material tracking and inventory control system. Monitor material requisitions, purchase orders, pending supplies and delivery schedules. Ensure proper reconciliation of material receipts, issues, returns, transfers and consumption. Identify material shortages, excess inventory and potential supply risks and take corrective measures. Monitor inventory accuracy and coordinate periodic physical stock verification. Prepare regular reports on material availability, inventory position, consumption and shipment status. F. Strategic Sourcing & Cost Optimization Develop effective sourcing strategies for raw materials, packaging materials, machinery, equipment and services. Identify, evaluate and develop reliable local and international suppliers. Conduct supplier negotiations to secure competitive pricing, quality, delivery and payment terms. Analyze procurement and commercial costs and identify opportunities for cost reduction. Monitor supplier performance in terms of quality, price, delivery and service. Develop alternative sourcing options to minimize supply risks and ensure business continuity. G. Coordination, Team Management & Reporting Coordinate with Production, Planning, Procurement, Finance, Commercial, Quality Assurance and Warehouse teams. Lead, supervise and develop the SCM team to achieve departmental objectives. Prepare and present regular MIS reports on production material requirements, procurement, project sourcing, contract status, LC position, shipment tracking and inventory. Establish effective internal controls and ensure proper documentation and audit compliance. Monitor departmental KPIs and take corrective actions to improve performance. Drive continuous improvement, operational efficiency and cost optimization.

দায়িত্ব ও কর্তব্য হাসপাতালের চিকিৎসাসেবা, বিভিন্ন বিভাগ, রোগ নির্ণয় ও অন্যান্য স্বাস্থ্যসেবা সম্পর্কে প্রচার ও বিপণন কার্যক্রম পরিচালনা করা। নতুন রোগী, প্রাতিষ্ঠানিক গ্রাহক এবং বিভিন্ন প্রতিষ্ঠানের চিকিৎসক, বিশেষজ্ঞ বিভাগ এবং চিকিৎসাসেবার সুযোগ-সুবিধা সম্পর্কে সম্ভাব্য রোগী ও সংশ্লিষ্ট প্রতিষ্ঠানকে সঠিক তথ্য প্রদান করা। বিভিন্ন প্রতিষ্ঠান ও কমিউনিটিতে হাসপাতালের স্বাস্থ্যসেবা প্রচারের জন্য সরাসরি যোগাযোগ, প্রতিষ্ঠান পরিদর্শন ও প্রচারণামূলক কার্যক্রম পরিচালনা করা। স্বাস্থ্যসচেতনতামূলক ক্যাম্প, বিনামূল্যে চিকিৎসাসেবা ক্যাম্প, প্রাতিষ্ঠানিক স্বাস্থ্য পরীক্ষা এবং অন্যান্য প্রচারমূলক কার্যক্রম আয়োজন ও সমন্বয় করা। হাসপাতালের ফেসবুক পেজ, সামাজিক যোগাযোগমাধ্যম এবং অন্যান্য ডিজিটাল মাধ্যমে প্রচারণামূলক কার্যক্রম পরিচালনায় সহায়তা করা। রোগী ও সম্ভাব্য গ্রাহকদের সঙ্গে নিয়মিত যোগাযোগ ও পরবর্তী খোঁজখবর বজায় রাখা। হাসপাতালের সেবার মান, রোগীদের মতামত এবং বাজারের চাহিদা সম্পর্কে তথ্য সংগ্রহ করে কর্তৃপক্ষকে অবহিত করা। প্রতিযোগী হাসপাতাল ও ডায়াগনস্টিক সেন্টারের কার্যক্রম পর্যবেক্ষণ করে নতুন বিপণন ও ব্যবসায়িক সুযোগ চিহ্নিত করা। দৈনিক বিপণন কার্যক্রম, প্রতিষ্ঠান পরিদর্শন, নতুন রোগী সংগ্রহ এবং ব্যবসায়িক অগ্রগতির প্রতিবেদন তৈরি করা। নির্ধারিত মাসিক বিপণন ও রোগী সংগ্রহের লক্ষ্যমাত্রা Field-based in Gaibandha district, with travel to assigned upazilas and locations as required Background The Regional Integrated Multi-Hazard Early Warning System for Africa and Asia (RIMES) is an international and inter-governmental institution that is owned and managed by its 48 Member and Collaborating States for building capacities in the generation and application of user-relevant multi-hazard early warning information, for resources and risks management. RIMES was established on 30 April 2009 through the signing by collaborating countries of the RIMES regional cooperation agreement. RIMES was registered with the United Nations under Article 102 of the UN Charter on 1 July 2009. RIMES Headquarters operates from its regional early warning center, located at the campus of the Asian Institute of Technology in Pathumthani, Thailand; country offices have been established strategically. RIMES' purpose is to provide early warning services according to differing needs and demands of its Member and Collaborating States, for enhanced preparedness and response to, and mitigation of, natural hazards. RIMES' approach is end-to-end, capacitating institutions and communities across the five distinct but inter-connected components of the early warning/climate information value chain: Improving data availability:  enhancing observation and monitoring systems for generating data, and facilitating seamless integration of data into a platform that can be easily accessed and used by various National Meteorological and Hydrological Services (NMHSs). Modelling and forecasting:  enhancing forecast skill, and forecast spatial and temporal resolutions, as required by stakeholders. Transforming data into information:  co-production of services between NMHSs and sectoral institutions for impact-based forecasting, including, but not limited to, the development of decision support systems (DSSs) for various sectors. Tailor-made services to deliver user-specific information for resources and risks management:  user requirements, assessed via the Climate Application Forum process and user needs assessment activities, serve as basis for evolving/designing and delivering early warning/risk information products. Stakeholder engagement/community outreach:  ensuring that customized early warning/climate information products reach communities through effective communication channels, and training communities to enable them to undertake forecast/early warning/risk information-based anticipatory action and provide feedback. The well-designed sustainable programs of Nobo Jibon through covering a huge number of beneficiaries are definitely contributing towards achieving Sustainable Development Goals (SDG). job_description: Position Purpose To lead and manage the overall Mechanical Maintenance and Engineering operations of Jamuna Paper Mills Ltd., ensuring reliable, efficient and uninterrupted operation of all mechanical systems, machinery, and equipment associated with  Duplex Board, Liner, Media, Kraft, and Simplex paper machines.  The position will be responsible for ensuring maximum machine availability, minimizing mechanical breakdowns and production downtime, implementing preventive and predictive maintenance programs, optimizing maintenance costs, ensuring equipment reliability and operational safety, and improving overall plant efficiency and productivity. Duties & Responsibilities Lead, supervise and manage all mechanical maintenance and engineering operations of the paper mill to ensure uninterrupted production activities. Ensure smooth operation, maintenance, trouble shooting and performance optimization of mechanical systems associated with  Duplex Board, Liner, Media, Kraft and Simplex paper machines. Oversee the installation, commissioning, operation, and maintenance of paper machines, mechanical equipment and associated production facilities. Develop and implement preventive, predictive and corrective maintenance plans to minimize equipment failures and unplanned production downtime. Lead mechanical troubleshooting activities and ensure timely resolution of technical problems affecting production operations. Ensure proper maintenance and reliable operation of paper machine components, including head boxes, forming sections, press sections, dryer sections, calendars, winders, pulpers, refiners, pumps, agitators, rollers, bearings, gears, couplings and transmission systems. Monitor machine performance, vibration, alignment, lubrication, temperature, and other critical mechanical parameters to ensure equipment reliability and operational efficiency. Ensure proper maintenance and efficient operation of utility equipment, including boilers, pumps, compressors, cooling towers, water treatment systems, pipelines, and other mechanical installations. Coordinate with Production, Electrical & Instrumentation, Utility, Supply Chain, and other relevant departments to ensure maximum machine availability and uninterrupted production. Ensure proper maintenance of mechanical drawings, equipment specifications, maintenance schedules, equipment history, and technical documentation. Monitor critical mechanical spare parts inventory and ensure timely availability of essential components to minimize equipment downtime. Lead, supervise, and develop the mechanical maintenance team, including engineers, supervisors, technicians, fitters, welders, and other technical personnel. job_description: Bio-Xin Cosmeceuticals Bio-Xin Cosmeceuticals is a leading provider of advanced skincare solutions, combining cutting-edge science with the finest natural ingredients. Our mission is to enhance beauty and wellness through innovative products and exceptional customer service. We are committed to making a positive impact on our customers' lives and the community. Job Purpose The Manager-Branch Sales and Operation will drive sustainable and profitable sales growth across Bio-Xin branches by converting company strategy into disciplined daily execution. The role will improve consultation-to-purchase and consultation-to-treatment conversion, average bill value, repeat business, lead follow-up, workforce productivity and branch accountability while protecting customer trust and clinical integrity. This is a field-intensive commercial leadership role. Success will be measured not only by revenue achievement, but also by the quality of execution, customer experience, ethical selling, retention, reporting accuracy and the branch team's ability to sustain improvement. Role Outcomes Consistent achievement of branch sales targets through disciplined planning and execution. Higher conversion from inquiry, walk-in, skin analysis and doctor consultation to appropriate product or treatment purchase. Growth in average bill value through responsible routine building, treatment planning, cross-selling and package conversion. Improved repeat purchase, treatment continuation, follow-up completion and inactive-customer reactivation. Stronger Branch Manager capability, frontline coaching and transparent performance accountability. A consistent customer journey across Sales, Doctors, Skin Therapists, Billing, CRM and Customer Care. Key Responsibilities Sales Strategy and Target Deployment Target planning: Translate company revenue objectives into branch-wise, category-wise, channel-wise and employee-wise monthly, weekly and daily targets. Opportunity sizing: Use branch capacity, customer traffic, lead volume, treatment-room availability, local demand, historical performance and campaign plans to set realistic but ambitious execution priorities. Action plans: Develop branch recovery plans, growth initiatives and resource requirements for branches that are below target. Sales rhythm: Establish morning huddles, midday checkpoints and end-of-day performance reviews so gaps are identified and acted on quickly. Forecasting: Maintain accurate sales forecasts and clearly communicate risks Branch Sales Performance Management Daily control: Monitor revenue, target achievement, customer footfall, consultation volume, conversion, average bill value, treatment bookings, product sales and collections. Performance diagnosis: Separate traffic, conversion, capacity, product availability, pricing, follow-up, service quality and people-performance issues before deciding corrective action. Branch reviews: Conduct structured weekly and monthly business reviews with Branch Managers using verified data and clearly assigned actions. Recovery management: Place persistently underperforming branches or employees on time-bound improvement plans with coaching, milestones and documented follow-up. Best-practice scaling: Identify successful branch practices and convert them into repeatable playbooks for the wider network. Conversion and Customer Journey Excellence Journey design: Strengthen the complete customer pathway from inquiry and reception through skin analysis, doctor consultation, recommendation, billing, treatment, homecare and follow-up. Consultative selling: Ensure teams identify customer needs, explain value clearly and recommend suitable solutions without pressure, exaggerated promises or unsupported guarantees. Conversion improvement: Analyze drop-off points and improve appointment show-up, consultation conversion, treatment-plan acceptance, product attachment and checkout completion. Communication consistency: Prevent contradictory information among Sales, Doctors, Skin Therapists, Billing and Customer Care through approved scripts, handovers and service standards. Service recovery: Resolve escalated concerns promptly and use complaint patterns to improve processes, communication and customer confidence. Branch Manager Leadership and Coaching Manager capability: Coach Branch Managers on target ownership, workforce deployment, pipeline management, team motivation, feedback, accountability and customer-service leadership. Field coaching: Observe real customer interactions, give specific feedback and demonstrate effective need discovery, value communication, objection handling and ethical closing. Performance culture: Build a culture where employees understand their numbers, actions, service standards and individual contribution to branch results. Succession: Identify high-potential employees and support development plans for future branch and sales leadership roles. Corrective management: Address repeated non-performance or non-compliance with facts, documented coaching and coordination with HR and line management. Doctor Therapist and Sales Coordination Clinical-commercial alignment: Create effective working coordination among Doctors, Skin Therapists and Sales teams while respecting professional and clinical boundaries. Treatment plans: Ensure doctor-approved treatment and homecare plans are explained clearly, accurately and consistently to customers. Capacity conversion: Align appointments, doctor availability, therapist rosters and treatment-room capacity with expected demand and campaign activity. Handover discipline: Standardize customer handovers so important information, next steps, payment clarity and follow-up commitments are not lost. Scope protection: Ensure non-clinical employees do not diagnose, prescribe, alter treatment parameters or make medical claims. Product and Treatment Sales Excellence Knowledge application: Ensure frontline teams understand Bio-Xin and BioCare products, aesthetic treatments, benefits, suitable customer profiles, usage, precautions and responsible claims. Routine building: Improve complete skincare routine recommendations and treatment-compatible homecare based on approved guidance. Value selling: Train teams to communicate treatment and product value, expected journey, required consistency and realistic outcomes instead of relying mainly on discounts. Portfolio focus: Drive balanced growth across priority products, treatments, packages, new launches and underdeveloped categories. Commercial feedback: Provide structured feedback on customer objections, price sensitivity, unmet needs and competitor activity to relevant teams. Lead CRM and Retention Operations Lead governance: Ensure inquiries, appointments, consultations, quotations, follow-ups and outcomes are recorded accurately in approved systems. Response standards: Monitor lead response time, contact attempts, appointment confirmation, no-show recovery and pending-decision follow-up. Retention: Create systematic reminders for treatment continuation, product replenishment, review appointments and routine adherence. Reactivation: Run data-led campaigns for dormant customers, incomplete treatment plans, abandoned inquiries and lapsed product users. Data discipline: Protect customer information and prevent unauthorized downloading, sharing, manipulation or use of CRM and ERP data. Campaign and Promotion Execution Branch readiness: Convert central campaigns into clear branch execution plans covering targets, scripts, displays, staffing, inventory, customer lists and follow-up. Offer accuracy: Ensure discounts, cashback, packages, validity, exclusions and payment conditions are explained and applied correctly. Local activation: Develop branch-level activations, referral initiatives and partnerships within approved brand and budget guidelines. Campaign review: Measure campaign traffic, conversion, incremental revenue, average bill, repeat value and execution quality. Learning loop: Document what worked, what failed and what should change before the next campaign. Inventory Billing and Revenue Protection Availability: Coordinate with Supply Chain and branches to reduce lost sales caused by stock-outs, device downtime, staffing gaps or appointment-capacity constraints. Billing discipline: Ensure invoices, treatment orders, packages, discounts, cashback and payment records are accurate and comply with approved policy. Leakage control: Monitor cancellations, refunds, complimentary services, unauthorized discounts, unbilled services, package misuse and unusual transaction patterns. Reconciliation: Work with Finance, Audit and Operations to investigate discrepancies and close corrective actions. Commercial integrity: Protect revenue without compromising customer rights, clinical judgment or ethical standards. Reporting Analytics and Management Insight Dashboard ownership: Maintain an accurate daily, weekly and monthly dashboard of branch commercial and customer metrics. Insight: Explain not only what changed, but why it changed, what action is required, who owns the action and when improvement is expected. Data validation: Reconcile source data and challenge incomplete, delayed or inconsistent branch reports. Management reporting: Submit concise performance summaries with achievements, risks, corrective actions and decisions required. Experimentation: Test improvement initiatives using baseline data, defined success measures and post-implementation review. Governance Risk and Ethical Sales Ethical standards: Prevent misleading claims, overpromising, inappropriate pressure selling, unnecessary treatment recommendations and manipulation of customer concerns. Clinical boundary: Ensure diagnosis, patient selection, contraindication assessment, medical clearance, prescriptions and clinical decisions remain with qualified Doctors. Policy compliance: Ensure branches follow company SOPs, pricing rules, consent requirements, data-security expectations and customer-care standards. Escalation: Immediately report suspected fraud, data misuse, safety risk, serious customer complaints, unauthorized clinical conduct or revenue leakage. Audit response: Support internal audits and ensure sales-related findings are closed within agreed timelines

We’re not afraid to do things differently and we continuously search and try new methods and technologies. Maintain and update M&E databases and ensure data quality assurance. Meeting Facilitation and Reporting Organize and facilitate regular coordination meetings with donors, government counterparts, local stakeholders, educational institutions and community groups. Lead the preparation of detailed monthly, quarterly, half-yearly, and final project reports, consolidating field insights, progress metrics, and lessons learned. Human Resource Support Assist in HR-related functions, including staff recruitment, orientation, performance management, and capacity development. Conduct annual staff performance appraisals and provide regular feedback to promote professional development. Maintain a capable and motivated project team aligned with organization’s values and project goals. Safeguarding and Compliance Ensure the safety and well-being of all team members by implementing safeguarding policies and fostering a secure working environment. Environmental Education and Knowledge Management Support the design and dissemination of environmental education materials targeting local communities and youth platforms. Facilitate the development, documentation, and compilation of case studies highlighting project achievements, best practices, and lessons learned. Manage and Coordinate cross-border knowledge exchange activities/engagements Communication, Advocacy, and Public Engagement Maintain effective communication with stakeholders for successful event management, campaign delivery, and project visibility. Build partnerships with relevant organizations, media outlets, and public platforms to amplify project outreach and advocacy efforts. Conduct post-campaign assessments to evaluate the impact of awareness initiatives and adjust strategies accordingly. Additional Responsibilities Perform other project-related tasks as assigned by senior management to support the overall success of WildTeam’s initiatives. Preferred Attitude, The most important quality WildTeam is looking for in all its employees is a positive can-do attitude and “One Team” approaches. In 1993, Dongjin Group was founded in Jiangxi,China and our main core of business is Sealed Lead Acid battery manufacturing. We specialize in SLA battery research and development from plate to battery and our products had 2 main brands, KINON and DONGJIN.

In order to support services nearer to customers location, we will not stop from here but will continue to explore to set up more factories in other countries in the near future.

গুরুত্বপূর্ণ ভূমিকা পালন করেন।   মূল দায়িত্বসমূহ (CORE RESPONSIBILITIES) অতিথিকে স্বাগত জানানো এবং আসন বিন্যাস (Guest Welcome & Seating) ডাইনিং হলে প্রবেশকারী অতিথিদের একটি বন্ধুত্বপূর্ণ এবং পেশাদার পেমেন্টের জন্য কীভাবে কিউআর কোড সিস্টেম ব্যবহার করতে হয় তা অতিথিদের বুঝিয়ে বলা ও গাইড করা। অতিথিদের তাদের মোবাইল ডিভাইস ব্যবহার করে টেবিলে থাকা কিউআর কোড স্ক্যান করে ডিজিটাল মেনু অ্যাক্সেস করতে সহায়তা সম্পর্কিত সাধারণ প্রযুক্তিগত সমস্যাগুলোর সমাধান করা এবং জটিল সমস্যাগুলো সুপারভাইজারের কাছে পাঠানো। টেবিল রক্ষণাবেক্ষণ এবং পরিচ্ছন্নতা (Table Maintenance & Cleanliness) অতিথিদের বসার আগে সমস্ত টেবিল পরিষ্কার, সুশৃঙ্খল এবং সঠিকভাবে প্রস্তুত রাখা নিশ্চিত করা। অতিথিদের খাবার শেষ হওয়ার সাথে সাথে দ্রুত টেবিল পরিষ্কার করা, মুছে ফেলা এবং নতুন করে সাজানো। প্রয়োজন অনুযায়ী টেবিলওয়্যার, মসলা এবং অন্যান্য টেবিল সামগ্রী পরিবর্তন করা। অতিথিদের জন্য একটি স্বাগত জানানোর মতো পরিবেশ নিশ্চিত করতে পুরো ডাইনিং এরিয়ার পরিচ্ছন্নতা বজায় রাখা। অতিথির অভিজ্ঞতা এবং সেবা (Guest Experience & Service) অতিথিদের পুরো এবং সময়োপযোগী উপায়ে সমাধান করা। ডাইনিংয়ের সময় অতিথিরা যেন স্বাগত, সমর্থিত এবং আরামদায়ক বোধ করেন তা নিশ্চিত করা। দলীয় সহযোগিতা (Team Collaboration) নির্বিঘ্ন সেবা নিশ্চিত করতে অন্যান্য ফ্লোর স্টাফ, স্বাক্ষর করাবেন এবং সদস্য দলত্যাগ করলে তার পাসবইয়ে পরিশোধ বা কোনো দেনা পাওনা নাই লিখে সদস্যকে ফেরত দিতে হবে। পলাতক সদস্য ও পুরাতন ঋণের টাকা আদায়ে সচেষ্ট থাকতে হবে। দলের সম্পাদক যদি রেজুলেশন খাতা লিখতে না পারেন তবে এবিএম’কে উক্ত দায়িত্ব পালন করতে হবে। আওতাধীন সকল সদস্যর বাড়ি/বাসা (১০০% সদস্যর) ভর্তি ও ঋণ বিতরণের পূর্বেই ভিজিট করতে হবে। সপ্তাহে ২ দিন (শনিবার ও মঙ্গলবার) বিগত সপ্তাহের পলাতক, চলতি খেলাপি, অসুস্থ্যতা ১০০% যাচাই করে বিএম এর নিকট লিখিত প্রতিবেদন দাখিল করবেন এবং তার কপি মাসভিত্তিক আরএম কে দেবেন। যে সকল ব্রাঞ্চে ক্ষুদ্র ব্যবসা ও এসএমইডি ঋণ আছে উক্ত ঋণের দল পরিচালনা সহ সার্বিক দায়িত্ব পালন করবেন। প্রতিদিন এলওদের আদায় সিট নিয়ে তা কম্পিউটারে পোস্টিং দিবেন। কম্পিউটার থেকে প্রতিদিন (ছুটি বাদে) দৈনিক তথ্য শিট ও প্রাপ্তি-পরিশোধ হিসাব প্রিন্ট করে ব্রাঞ্চ ম্যানেজারের এর নিকট জমা দিবেন। কম্পিউটারের সফটওয়্যারের মাধ্যমে যে সকল রিপোর্ট প্রয়োজন হবে তা প্রিন্ট করবেন এবং ব্রাঞ্চ ম্যানেজারের এর নিকট জমা দিবেন। ব্রাঞ্চ ম্যানেজারের এর অনুপস্থিতিতে ব্রাঞ্চ ম্যানেজারের এর দায়িত্ব পালন job_description: We are seeking a highly experienced, commercially oriented and strategic Head of Accounts & Finance to lead the Company's overall Finance & Accounts function. The position will operate at a CFO-equivalent level and will be responsible for financial strategy, planning and analysis, financial reporting, budgeting, cash-flow and working-capital management, costing, profitability analysis, inventory and royalty accounting, taxation, audit, risk management and internal controls. The incumbent will serve as a key financial adviser to the Managing Director/CEO and Board of Directors, providing reliable financial insights and recommendations to support business growth, profitability, investment, pricing, cost optimization and other strategic decisions. Financial Leadership & Strategic Management Lead and provide strategic direction to the Company's entire Finance & Accounts function. Develop and implement financial strategies aligned with the Company's business objectives and growth plans. Advise the Managing Director/CEO and Board on financial performance, investment, expansion, pricing, cost optimization, and business risks. Ensure financial discipline, accountability, transparency, and effective utilization of Company resources. Identify financial risks and recommend appropriate mitigation and corrective measures. Financial Reporting & Management Information Ensure accurate and timely preparation of monthly, quarterly and annual financial statements and management accounts in accordance with applicable BFRS/IFRS and Bangladesh laws and regulations. Ensure proper maintenance of books of accounts, ledgers, reconciliations, and supporting documentation. Prepare and review Profit & Loss, Balance Sheet, Cash Flow, Budget vs. Actual, Gross Margin, Product Profitability, Inventory Ageing, Receivable Ageing, Payable Ageing, and other management reports. Provide timely financial analysis and business insights to senior management and the Board. Budgeting, Forecasting & Business Planning Lead preparation of annual operating and capital budgets. Develop financial forecasts, cash-flow projections, and long-term financial plans. Monitor actual performance against budget and conduct detailed variance analysis. Recommend corrective actions to improve financial and operational performance. Support management in business planning, financial modelling, and feasibility analysis for new projects and investments. Costing & Profitability Establish and maintain an effective product-wise costing and profitability system. Evaluate product-wise cost, selling price, discount, contribution margin, and profitability. Inventory, Sales & Working Capital Establish strong financial controls over materials and other inventories. Monitor inventory levels, stock movements, slow-moving, obsolete, damaged, and unsaleable stock. Ensure periodic physical verification and reconciliation of inventory with accounting records. Monitor sales, returns, discounts, trade schemes, receivables and collection performance. Establish appropriate credit-control procedures and monitor customer/distributor credit exposure. Drive improvement in working-capital efficiency, receivables collection and inventory utilization. Treasury & Cash-Flow Management Lead the Company's cash-flow, treasury, and liquidity management. Prepare and monitor daily, weekly, and monthly cash-flow requirements. Ensure sufficient liquidity for printing, paper procurement, salaries, royalties, suppliers, and other business obligations. Monitor bank facilities, loans, overdrafts, financing costs, and banking relationships. Optimize utilization of surplus funds in accordance with Company policy and applicable laws. Tax, VAT, Audit & Regulatory Compliance Ensure compliance with the applicable Income Tax Act 2023, VAT and Supplementary Duty Act 2012, RJSC requirements, and other relevant laws and regulations. Ensure timely tax/VAT returns, withholding tax compliance, and maintenance of supporting documentation. Coordinate statutory, tax, VAT, and internal audits. Liaise effectively with auditors, NBR, VAT authorities, tax consultants, and other regulatory bodies. Ensure timely resolution of audit observations, tax/VAT queries and regulatory matters. Internal Control, Risk Management & Governance Establish, review and continuously strengthen financial policies, procedures and internal controls. Ensure appropriate segregation of duties, authorization limits and approval procedures. Strengthen controls over procurement, inventory, sales, returns, discounts, cash, banking, payroll, royalty and fixed assets. Review significant or unusual transactions and identify potential financial irregularities and risks. Ensure proper documentation and compliance with approved financial policies. Procurement, Payroll & Fixed Assets Establish appropriate financial controls over procurement and other materials. Review major supplier balances, payment schedules, commercial terms and procurement contracts from a financial perspective. Ensure appropriate three-way matching of Purchase Order, Goods Received Note and Supplier Invoice. Supervise payroll accounting, statutory deductions, employee advances, loans and benefits. Ensure proper accounting, verification and control of fixed assets and capital expenditure. Team Leadership Lead, develop and mentor the Finance & Accounts team. Establish clear responsibilities, performance standards and accountability within the finance function. Build a strong, professional and business-oriented finance team capable of supporting the Company's growth. Promote integrity, confidentiality, continuous improvement, and financial discipline

শাখায় ফিরে শাখা ব্যবস্থাপক কর্তৃক কালেকশন শীট চেক করার পর হিসাবরক্ষকের নিকট কালেকশন শীট অনুযায়ী আদায়কৃত টাকা নির্ভুল টপশীট তৈরী করে বুঝিয়ে দিবেন। বিকেল বেলা মুভমেন্ট করে মাঠ পর্যয়ে বেরিয়ে পড়বেন। শাখা প্রয়োজনীয় জ্ঞান অর্জন করা ও বাস্তবায়ন করা। কর্তৃপক্ষের নির্দেশ মোতাবেক যেকোন সময় যেকোন দায়িত্ব পালন করা। এ ছাড়াও সোপিরেট আপনাকে যেকোন দুর্যোগকালীন সময়ে কাজে নিয়োজিত করতে পারবে।

job_description: Company Description:-  Bangladesh Psychiatric Care Limited (BPCL) is the first comprehensive psychiatric consultation center in Bangladesh, offering world-class mental health solutions under one roof. With a team of globally recognized psychiatrists and expert psychotherapists, BPCL provides holistic care for mental health needs. BPCL is dedicated to its mission of being a one-stop solution for mental health and improving quality of life through quality care. Role Description:-  This is a full-time, on-site role based in Dhaka, Bangladesh, for a Speech & Language Therapist. The therapist will evaluate, diagnose, and treat individuals with speech, language, and communication disorders, as well as manage swallowing difficulties (dysphagia). Key responsibilities include creating tailored therapy plans, collaborating with multidisciplinary teams, monitoring patient progress, and educating caregivers to support ongoing development. The therapist will work closely with BPCL's expert team to ensure a comprehensive approach to patient care. Job Responsibilities:- Conduct comprehensive assessments of speech, language, communication, and swallowing abilities using standardized and non-standardized tools. Identify and diagnose disorders related to articulation, fluency, voice, comprehension, and expressive language. Develop individualized therapy plans (ITPs) based on assessment outcomes and client-specific needs. Deliver targeted interventions for speech delays, language disorders, autism-related communication challenges, social communication issues, and stuttering. Provide therapy for feeding and oral-motor difficulties where clinically indicated. Monitor client progress through regular session notes, evaluations, and progress reports, adjusting interventions as required. Maintain accurate, detailed, and confidential client records in compliance with organizational standards. Educate and train parents/caregivers on home-based communication strategies to support skill generalization. Collaborate effectively with multidisciplinary teams including psychologists, occupational therapists, special educators, and behavior therapists. Participate in case conferences, continuous professional development, and report to the Clinical Lead or DMS.

Promote maternal health awareness, early recognition of danger signs, and timely access to healthcare services. Gynaecological Care and Reproductive Health Diagnose and manage common gynaecological conditions, including menstrual disorders, pelvic pain, reproductive tract infections, and other reproductive health concerns. job_description: দায়িত্ব ও কর্তব্য: নিয়মিত সমস্ত হিসাব-নিকাশ হালনাগাদসহ যাবতীয় প্রতিবেদন তৈরী ও রক্ষণা-বেক্ষণ করা। শাখার যাবতীয় অর্থনৈতিক ও ঋণের বার্ষিক বাজেট তৈরী ও পরিকল্পনায় সহযোগিতা করা। শাখার দৈনিক আর্থিক পরিকল্পনা পূর্ববর্তী দিনেই প্রস্তুত করে আর্থিক কর্মকান্ড নীতিমালা অনুযায়ী সাবলীলভাবে পরিচালনা করা। শাখার ষ্টোরের যাবতীয় হিসাব-নিকাশ রক্ষণা-বেক্ষণ করা। প্রতিদিন কমপক্ষে একটি সমিতির ঋণ-পাশবহি উক্ত সমিতির ঋণ রেজিষ্টারের সাথে জের মিলকরণ করা। প্রস্তাবিত ঋণ-আবেদনপত্রের ক্ষেত্রে আবেদনকারীর আবেদনকৃত ঋণের বিপরিতে নিয়মানুযায়ী পর্যাপ্ত সঞ্চয় আছে কিনা, পূর্ববর্তী ঋণ পরিশোধ হয়েছে কিনা তা ঋণি যাচাই ও ঋণ বিতরণের পূর্ববর্তী দিনের মধ্যেই পরীক্ষা করতে হবে। নিয়মিতভাবে ক্যাশবহি, খতিয়ান বহিসহ হিসাবরক্ষণ সম্পর্কিত হিসাবের যাবতীয়বইসমূহ হালনাগাদ রাখা ও যাবতীয় প্রতিবেদন তৈরী ও রক্ষনাবেক্ষন করা। প্রতিদিনের ক্যাশবই অনুসারে হাতে নগদ টাকার স্থিতি সংরক্ষণ করা। হিসাববহিতে লিপিবদ্ধকরণ ব্যতিরেকে অতিরিক্ত অর্থ হাতে না রাখা অথবা হিসাববহিতে লিপিবদ্ধ করে হাতে নগদ স্থিতি কম না রাখা। মাঠ কর্মীদের নিকট হতে দৈনিক কিস্তি ও সঞ্চয়ের টাকা গ্রহণ এবং তা ব্যাংকে জমা ও চাহিদাপত্র অনুযায়ী ব্যাংক হতে টাকা উত্তোলন করা। অনুমোদনকৃত বেতন, ভাতা ও অন্যান্য বিল ভাউচার পরীক্ষা-নিরীক্ষা শেষে কর্মীদের প্রদান করা। কর্মসূচীর সফল বাস্তবায়নে Credit Management Team কর্তৃক প্রদত্ত যে কোন দায়িত্ব পালন করা। মাঠের বাস্তব অভিজ্ঞতার আলোকে ঋণ কর্মসূচী সংক্রান্ত বিভিন্ন ফরম তৈরী, কর্মকৌশল বিষয়ে Credit Management Team কে প্রয়োজনীয় সহায়তা প্রদান। প্রতিমাসের শেষে বিস্তারিতভাবে অর্থনৈতিক প্রতিবেদন নির্বাহী পরিচালকের নিকট দাখিল করা। এ ছাড়াও বিশেষ বিশেষ সময় সংস্থা কর্তৃক অর্পিত অন্যান্য দায়িত্ব পালন করবেন।

গঠনের পূর্বে ভৌগলিক অবস্থা বিবেচনা করে সমিতি গঠন এবং সদস্যদের সামজিক ও পারিবরিক অবস্থান যাচাইপূর্বক সমিতির সদস্যপদ প্রদানে মাঠ ব্যবস্থাপকদের সহায়তা করা, বিগত ও বর্তমান প্রকল্পের অর্থনৈতিক সফলতা ও বিফলতা বিশ্লেষণ করে প্রাথমিকভাবে চুড়ান্তকরণ ইত্যাদি বিষয় বিশেষভাবে গুরুত্ব দিয়ে ক্ষুদ্রঋণ কার্যক্রম সফলভাবে বাস্তবায়নে অগ্রণী ভুমিকা পালন করা।  সংস্থার ক্ষুদ্রঋণ কার্যক্রমের আওতায় সংগঠিত সমিতির সদস্য, মাঠ ব্যবস্থাপক ও শাখা ব্যবস্থাপকের জন্য প্রস্তুতকৃত হ্যান্ডবিল নিয়মিত চর্চা করা ও মাঠ পর্যায়ে প্রচারনা চালানো। নিয়মিত মাঠে গিয়ে সঞ্চয় ও ঋণ পাশ বই এবং রেজিষ্টারের সাথে প্রত্যেক সদস্যার সঞ্চয় ও ঋণ হিসাব মিলিয়ে দেখা। সমিতির কোন সদস্য ঋণ খেলাপী হলে সমিতির অন্যান্য সদস্য ও জামিনদারের সহযোগিতা নিয়ে, নিয়মিত সমিতির সদস্যদের সাথে কর্মীদের যোগাযোগে উৎসাহিত করা এবং কর্মীদের সমন্বয়ে টিম গঠনপূর্বক খেলাপী আদায়ে বাস্তবমুখি পদক্ষেপ গ্রহণসহ আপনি নিজেও টিমে যুক্ত হবেন। কর্মীদের মাঝে আন্তঃসম্পর্ক উন্নয়ন, অর্জিত অভিজ্ঞতা, কৌশল ও পদ্ধতি ইত্যাদি বিষয়ে ধারাবাহিকভাবে মতবিনিময় করা। সমিতির প্রতি সদস্যর বাড়ি সরেজমিনে পরিদর্শন এবং সদস্যদের সাথে সম্পর্ক উন্নয়ন করা। অনুরূপ দায়িত্ব পালন প্রতি মাঠ ব্যবস্থাপকের জন্য বাধ্যতামূলক। সংস্থার ঋণ প্রশাসন নীতিমালা অনুযায়ী ঋণ প্রদান ও আদায়, সঞ্চয় আদায় সময়মত ও নিয়ম মাফিক হচ্ছে কিনা তা যাচাই করা। প্রতিমাসের শেষে এরিয়া ম্যানেজারের নিকট পরবর্তী মাসের পরিকল্পনা পেশ করা যাতে বিস্তাারিতভাবে প্রতিদিনের কাজ, সময় ও স্থানের বিবরণ থাকবে। মাঠ পর্যায়ে ঋণ দান কর্মসূচী ও কর্মীদের দায়িত্ব ও কর্তব্য মনিটরিং ও ঋড়ষষড়ি টঢ় এবং ঋণ কর্মসূচী পরিচালনা ক্ষেত্রে সৃষ্ট সমস্যাসমূহ কর্মী সমন্বয় সভায় যৌথ আলোচনা পূর্বক তাৎক্ষনিকভাবে অতিক্রমের পদক্ষেপ গ্রহণের কলাকৌশল অবলম্বণ করা। মাঠ ব্যবস্থাপকের অনুপস্থিতিতে তার দায়িত্বে পরিচালিত সমিতিসমূহের কালেকশনসহ যাবতীয় দায়িত্ব সাময়িকভাবে আপনার উপর ন্যস্ত থাকবে।  শাখার হিসাব ব্যবস্থাপনা পদ্ধতি ও কলাকৌশল শিখে নেওয়া এবং প্রতিনিয়ত যাচাই করা। আপনি ক্ষুদ্রঋণ কার্যক্রমের যাবতীয় প্রতিবেদন প্রস্তুত ক্ষেত্রে কম্পিউটার ব্যবহার করবেন এবং শাখার সমস্ত কর্মীর কম্পিউটার ব্যবহার নিশ্চিত করবেন। আপনি নিয়মিত সাপ্তাহিক ও মাসিক কর্মী সমন্বয় সভার সভাপতির দায়িত্ব পালন করবেন। কর্মী সমন্বয় সভায় প্রস্তাবিত প্রকল্প যাচাই ও নতুন সদস্য ভর্তি, বকেয়া ঋণি সদস্য, নিস্ক্রিয় সদস্য, পলাতক সদস্য প্রভৃতি বিষয়ে আলোচনা চলমান রাখা এবং মোবাইল ফোনে যোগাযোগ অব্যাহত রাখা। শুধু তাই নয় ইত্যাদি বিষয়ে তাৎক্ষনিকভাবে কার্যকরি ব্যবস্থা গ্রহন করা। কর্মী সমন্বয় সভায় আলোচিত প্রতিটি বিষয়ে আপনার দায়িত্বে রেজুলেশন প্রস্তুত এবং বিষয়টি নিয়মিত ও ধারাবাহিকভাবে চলমান রাখা।  শাখার অফিসিয়াল যাবতীয় job_description: To collect, consolidate, analyze, and interpret sales and business data to provide actionable insights to management for informed decision-making. The position will monitor the entire sales pipeline, including untouched leads, leads under process, leads at the final negotiation stage, and closed cases. The role will also identify sales trends, conversion gaps, business opportunities, and performance improvement areas to support the achievement of the company`s sales targets. A. Sales Data Analysis & Reporting Collect, consolidate, and analyze sales data from different departments, SBUs, and sales teams. Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly sales performance reports against targets. Analyze project-wise, area-wise, apartment-wise, land-wise, and SBU-wise sales performance. Monitor actual sales against targets and identify performance gaps. Prepare management reports and dashboards to support strategic and operational decision-making. B. Lead Pipeline Management & Analysis o    Monitor and analyze leads throughout the entire sales pipeline, including new Leads, Untouched Leads, Contacted Leads, Leads Under Process, Leads at the Final Stage, Closed case Track the number, value, age, and status of leads at each stage of the sales pipeline. Identify untouched, delayed, inactive, and high-potential leads requiring immediate attention. Analyze the reasons for lead conversion, loss, delay, and stagnation. Monitor lead follow-up frequency and the time taken to move leads from one stage to another. Prepare reports on lead conversion rates, stage-wise conversion, and pending opportunities. Highlight high-value leads and closing opportunities for management`s attention. C. Sales Performance & Conversion Analysis Analyze the performance of individual sales executives, sales teams, and business units. Calculate lead-to-sale conversion rates and identify areas where potential sales are being lost. Identify the sources of leads that generate the highest number of successful sales. Analyze the average time required to convert a lead into a booking or completed sale. Evaluate the effectiveness of sales campaigns and marketing activities. Identify recurring sales challenges and recommend data-supported improvement measures. D. Management Dashboard & Business Intelligence Develop and maintain interactive dashboards using Microsoft Excel, Power BI, or other appropriate business intelligence tools. Present key performance indicators (KPIs) through charts, tables, trend analysis, and management summaries. Provide ad hoc reports and data analysis as requested by management. E. Data Accuracy & CRM Monitoring Collect sales and lead data from the CRM, sales teams, marketing department, and other relevant sources. Verify data accuracy, completeness, consistency, and timely updates. Identify missing information, duplicate leads, inconsistent statuses, and outdated records. Coordinate with the sales team to ensure that lead status, follow-up dates, expected closing dates, and sales outcomes are updated correctly. Maintain standardized reporting formats and definitions for sales and lead-related data. Ensure the confidentiality and appropriate use of business and customer information. F. Marketing Insights & Market Analysis Collect, consolidate, and analyze market intelligence related to the real estate industry, including market trends, customer preferences, and emerging business opportunities. Gather information on competitors’ projects, apartment and land prices, locations, payment plans, promotional offers, and other relevant market activities. Collect and analyze customer feedback, buying preferences, objections, and reasons for selecting or rejecting the company`s projects. Analyze market demand for apartments, land, commercial spaces, and other real estate products, as applicable. Monitor competitors` marketing strategies, sales campaigns, pricing policies, and promotional activities to identify potential competitive advantages. Analyze lead sources, marketing campaign performance, and lead conversion rates to identify the most effective marketing channels. Identify emerging market trends, customer segments, and potential locations for future business opportunities. Collect market intelligence from sales teams, marketing teams, customer interactions, industry publications, online platforms, and other relevant sources. Prepare periodic market intelligence reports highlighting competitors` activities, market opportunities, customer expectations, and potential business risks. Present actionable market insights and data-driven recommendations to management to support strategic planning, pricing decisions, marketing initiatives, and business development. G. Sales Forecasting & Business Insights Forecast potential sales based on historical performance, active leads, conversion rates, and expected closing dates. Estimate potential revenue from leads at different stages of the sales pipeline. Identify projects, products, or market segments with strong or weak sales performance. Analyze reasons for underperformance and recommend possible corrective actions. Identify opportunities to improve lead utilization, follow-up efficiency, conversion rates, and revenue generation. Provide data-driven recommendations to management for sales planning, resource allocation, and business development. H. Coordination & Management Support Coordinate with Sales, Marketing, CRM, Finance, and other relevant departments to obtain and validate business data. Conduct periodic data review meetings with relevant stakeholders, when required. Highlight critical issues, delayed opportunities, and significant deviations from sales targets. ভিডিও নিজে ধারণ করা। পণ্যের বৈশিষ্ট্য, ব্যবহার, সুবিধা ও বিশেষ অফার তুলে ধরে আকর্ষণীয় ভিডিও তৈরি করা। প্রয়োজনে ভিডিওতে নিজে উপস্থাপনা করা অথবা উপযুক্ত ব্যক্তির মাধ্যমে উপস্থাপনা করানো। গ্রাফিক ডিজাইন ইংরেজিতে আকর্ষণীয় ক্যাপশন, পণ্যের বিবরণ, বিজ্ঞাপনের লেখা ও প্রচারণামূলক বার্তা তৈরি করা। প্রতিষ্ঠানের ফেসবুক পেজ এবং অন্যান্য নির্ধারিত ডিজিটাল প্ল্যাটফর্মে পোস্ট, ছবি, ভিডিও ও রিলস প্রকাশ করা। job_description: Job Context Target Group is looking for an experienced and proactive professional for the position of Manager – Tax & VAT to oversee the Group's taxation and VAT compliance activities across its manufacturing entities. The incumbent will be responsible for ensuring compliance with applicable Bangladesh tax and VAT laws, managing tax and VAT returns, coordinating with regulatory authorities, supporting audits and assessments, and implementing effective tax and VAT control systems. The position requires strong technical knowledge of Bangladesh taxation and VAT regulations, hands-on experience in the manufacturing/RMG sector, and the ability to manage compliance activities across multiple business entities. Job Responsibilities Tax Compliance & Management Ensure timely preparation and submission of corporate income tax returns for all applicable Group entities. Manage withholding tax (TDS) compliance, including deduction, deposit, return submission, and issuance of tax deduction certificates. Oversee advance tax calculations, payments, and tax assessments. Review tax computations, financial transactions, and supporting documentation to ensure accuracy and compliance. Identify tax risks and opportunities for lawful tax planning and optimization. VAT Compliance & Management Ensure timely preparation and submission of monthly VAT returns (Mushak-9.1) and other applicable VAT statements. Monitor VAT registration, enlistment, and compliance requirements for all relevant Group entities. Ensure proper maintenance of VAT registers, including purchase, sales, input VAT, and output VAT records. Review and ensure proper preparation and documentation of applicable Mushak forms, including Mushak-6.3, 6.6, 6.10, and other relevant forms. Monitor VAT deduction at source (VDS), VAT payments, adjustments, rebates, and input VAT credit eligibility. Ensure proper VAT treatment of local purchases, imports, exports, and intercompany transactions. Regulatory Liaison & Tax/VAT Assessments Maintain professional communication and liaison with the National Board of Revenue (NBR), relevant tax offices, and VAT authorities. Handle tax and VAT notices, queries, assessments, hearings, and related documentation. Coordinate with external tax consultants, auditors, and legal advisors where necessary. Support the resolution of tax and VAT disputes in accordance with applicable laws and regulations. Audit & Risk Management Coordinate internal and external tax and VAT audits, assessments, and inspections. Ensure proper preparation and submission of audit-related documents and supporting evidence. Identify tax and VAT compliance gaps, risks, and potential financial exposures. Develop and monitor corrective action plans to address identified compliance issues. Maintain audit-ready tax and VAT documentation for all relevant Group entities. Documentation  Maintain accurate and updated tax and VAT files, registers, returns, certificates, challans, and supporting documents. Ensure proper reconciliation of tax and VAT records with financial statements and accounting records. Monitor ERP/accounting system entries to ensure accurate tax and VAT treatment of transactions. Support the automation and digitalization of tax and VAT compliance processes. Group Coordination & Reporting Coordinate tax and VAT compliance activities across Group factories and corporate office functions. Work closely with Finance, Accounts, Commercial, HR, and factory management to ensure timely compliance. Prepare periodic tax and VAT compliance reports, risk assessments, and updates for management. Monitor statutory deadlines and ensure timely completion of all tax and VAT obligations. Process Improvement & Regulatory Updates Keep updated on changes in Bangladesh tax and VAT laws, rules, regulations, and NBR circulars. Assess the impact of regulatory changes and implement necessary compliance measures. Identify opportunities for process improvement, operational efficiency, and lawful tax optimization. Establish effective internal controls and standard operating procedures for tax and VAT management.

We are looking for a professional leader who can establish a well-organized, efficient, patient-centered, and financially sustainable hospital. Key Responsibilities 1. Hospital Development and Startup Operations Lead the overall planning, development, establishment, and commissioning of the hospital. Prepare the hospital development roadmap, operational plan, implementation timeline, and pre-opening budget. Establish the organizational structure, departmental hierarchy, reporting system, and management framework. Coordinate infrastructure development, medical equipment procurement, IT systems, staffing, and operational readiness. Ensure all essential departments and support services are prepared before the hospital opens. 2. Clinical Department Development and Coordination Oversee the planning, establishment, and operational readiness of the following departments: Outpatient Department (OPD). Inpatient Department (IPD). Intensive Care Unit (ICU). Coronary Care Unit (CCU). Neonatal Intensive Care Unit (NICU). Emergency Department and emergency response services. Dental Department. Eye and Ophthalmology Department. Physiotherapy and Rehabilitation Department. Laboratory and Diagnostic Services. Radiology and Imaging Services. Pharmacy and Medical Stores. Operation Theatre, Recovery, and Sterile Services, where applicable. Other clinical and non-clinical departments according to the hospital's approved service scope. Ensure proper departmental infrastructure, equipment, qualified manpower, patient flow, service protocols, and coordination among all departments. 3. Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) Develop and implement a comprehensive hospital SOP and policy manual. Establish department-specific SOPs, checklists, workflow charts, reporting formats, and operational guidelines. Develop procedures for patient registration, admission, discharge, emergency management, infection prevention, medication management, medical records, billing, procurement, and inventory control. Establish document control, staff training, compliance monitoring, internal audits, and corrective action systems. Ensure that SOPs are reviewed and approved by the appropriate management and clinical authorities. 4. Hospital Administration and Human Resources Establish a professional hospital administration and management system. Lead recruitment planning and coordinate the appointment of qualified doctors, nurses, technicians, administrators, and support personnel. Develop staffing structures, duty rosters, job descriptions, reporting lines, and performance appraisal systems. Ensure verification of professional qualifications, registrations, and credentials as required. Implement staff orientation, training, discipline, employee engagement, and performance management procedures. 5. Regulatory Compliance and Licensing Coordinate the necessary hospital licensing, approvals, registrations, and inspections. Ensure compliance with applicable Bangladesh healthcare regulations and requirements of relevant authorities, including DGHS. Maintain compliance records, license renewal schedules, inspection reports, and corrective action plans. Coordinate fire safety, environmental management, occupational safety, patient confidentiality, and medical record management. Ensure that clinical services are operated by appropriately qualified and authorized professionals. 6. Financial Management and Budget Control Prepare pre-opening budgets, departmental budgets, operating budgets, and cash-flow forecasts. Monitor hospital revenue, expenses, payroll, procurement costs, inventory, and financial performance. Establish financial controls, purchase approval procedures, billing systems, and reporting mechanisms. Monitor revenue collection, outstanding receivables, operational costs, and budget utilization. Identify cost optimization opportunities without compromising patient safety or service quality. Submit regular financial and operational reports to the Managing Director and Board of Directors. 7. Procurement, Equipment, and Facility Management Prepare medical equipment specifications and departmental procurement plans. Coordinate vendor selection, quotations, purchasing, installation, commissioning, and acceptance. Establish preventive maintenance and calibration schedules for medical equipment. Ensure adequate stock of medicines, consumables, medical supplies, and essential inventory. Monitor oxygen supply, generators, electrical systems, HVAC, water supply, sanitation, security, housekeeping, and waste management. Maintain reliable backup arrangements for critical hospital infrastructure. 8. Quality Assurance and Patient Safety Establish a hospital-wide quality assurance and patient safety framework. Monitor patient satisfaction, waiting times, complaints, service quality, and departmental performance. Coordinate clinical audits and patient safety reviews with the Medical Director and relevant clinical leaders. Implement incident reporting, root-cause analysis, corrective action, and continuous improvement systems. Promote infection prevention, patient dignity, informed consent, confidentiality, and professional ethics. 9. Hospital Information Systems Oversee the implementation of a Hospital Management Information System (HMIS/HMS). Coordinate patient registration, electronic medical records where applicable, billing, pharmacy, laboratory, radiology, inventory, HR, and financial modules. Establish accurate reporting systems, management dashboards, data security, and backup procedures. 10. job_description: Job Location:  Factory Location (Bangladesh) Position:  Production Manager (PM) – Steel & Rolling Mill Department:  Factory Operations / Production Industry:  Steel & Re-Rolling Mill / Steel Manufacturing Steel Melting & Steelmaking Operations Supervise and control steelmaking operations using induction furnaces or other installed steelmaking equipment to ensure consistent molten steel quality and production efficiency. Plan melting operations according to production requirements, approved steel grades, raw material availability, and billet specifications. Monitor furnace operating conditions, melting progress, bath temperature, power consumption, melting cycle time, and molten steel readiness. Monitor melting productivity, furnace utilization, heat cycle time, metal recovery, and production losses. Identify operational problems affecting melting efficiency, steel quality, and production continuity, and implement corrective measures. Chemical Composition & Steel Grade Control Ensure that molten steel and finished billets meet the approved chemical composition requirements for the specified steel grade. Coordinate with the laboratory team for representative sampling and chemical analysis using available testing equipment, including spectrometers where installed. Monitor the control of carbon, manganese, silicon, sulfur, phosphorus, and other specified alloying or residual elements as applicable to the approved steel grade. Review test results and coordinate necessary corrective actions before molten steel is released for casting. Ensure proper control and documentation of alloy additions, deoxidizers, and other approved steelmaking materials. Maintain heat-wise chemical composition records, material traceability, and test documentation. Investigate chemical composition deviations, material mix-ups, and recurring quality issues to prevent non-conforming steel production. Molten Steel Temperature & Process Control Monitor molten steel temperature at critical stages of melting, tapping, ladle handling, and casting. Coordinate with furnace and casting operators to maintain appropriate temperature ranges according to the approved process and casting requirements. Prevent operational delays that may cause excessive temperature loss, unnecessary holding time, or unstable casting conditions. Ensure proper tapping practices, slag carryover control, and safe transfer of molten steel. Coordinate ladle preparation, refractry condition monitoring, and equipment readiness with the responsible teams. Analyze temperature-related casting defects and production losses and implement suitable process improvements. Continuous Casting & Billet Manufacturing Supervise continuous casting machine operations, where installed, including tundish preparation, casting sequence, mould operation, cooling water systems, withdrawal speed, and billet cutting. Ensure stable casting conditions and proper coordination between molten steel supply and casting capacity. Monitor billet dimensions, surface condition, straightness, identification, and heat-wise traceability. Coordinate with the Quality Control team to inspect billet quality and identify surface cracks, internal defects, segregation, porosity, and other casting-related abnormalities where applicable. Monitor casting interruptions, rejected billets, metal losses, and production yield. Ensure proper cooling, handling, storage, and segregation of billets according to quality and production requirements. Billet Quality & Metallurgical Defect Prevention Establish and implement billet inspection and acceptance procedures in coordination with Quality Control. Investigate billet defects such as surface cracks, corner cracks, inclusions, seams, segregation, internal porosity, and dimensional irregularities. Identify the relationship between raw material quality, chemical composition, melting practice, casting conditions, and downstream rolling defects. Ensure that rejected or suspect billets are identified, segregated, and prevented from entering production without the required approval. Coordinate root-cause analysis and corrective actions for recurring billet quality problems. Maintain billet heat numbers, batch identification, inspection records, and traceability throughout the production process. Steel Yield, Metallic Recovery & Consumption Control Monitor metallic charge consumption, molten steel output, casting yield, billet recovery, and process losses. Analyze melting loss, slag loss, rejected heats, casting loss, and billet rejection in coordination with the relevant departments. Optimize raw material utilization and production efficiency without compromising chemical composition or product quality. Prepare heat-wise and shift-wise reports covering production output, yield, energy consumption, rejection, and operating performance. Implement corrective actions to improve metallic recovery, reduce avoidable losses, and control steelmaking cost per metric ton. Coordination Between Steelmaking & Deformed Bar Rolling Ensure that billet chemical composition, dimensions, temperature, and quality are suitable for the intended Deformed Bar / Rebar production requirements. Coordinate billet grade and size selection with the rolling mill production plan and approved product specifications. Investigate rolling defects associated with billet quality, including surface defects, cracks, inconsistent material properties, and dimensional variation. Work closely with Rolling Production and Quality Control teams to trace finished-product issues back to the relevant billet heat or production batch. Plant Safety, Environmental Compliance & Reporting Ensure safe handling of molten steel, hot metal, ladles, furnaces, casting equipment, and associated material handling systems. Coordinate with maintenance teams for furnace lining, refractory inspection, cooling systems, electrical equipment, and critical machinery reliability. Monitor dust, slag, waste handling, and other environmental control requirements applicable to the installed plant. Prepare daily and monthly steelmaking reports covering heats produced, billet tonnage, chemical compliance, casting performance, yield, rejection, energy consumption, and downtime. Report major technical issues, production risks, and improvement recommendations to the Production Head / General Manager. Rolling Mill Production & Operations Plan, organize, and supervise daily production of MS Rod / Deformed Bar in different sizes and specifications. Manage the complete rolling process, including billet feeding, reheating furnace, roughing stands, intermediate stands, finishing stands, cooling bed, cutting, and bundling. Prepare production schedules according to order requirements, raw material availability, and delivery targets. Monitor rolling speed, production temperature, mill synchronization, and machine performance to maintain continuous production. Ensure optimum mill utilization and achievement of daily and monthly production targets. Billet Reheating Furnace Management Supervise billet charging, furnace operation, heating zones, soaking time, and billet discharge. Maintain proper billet heating temperatures according to billet size, steel grade, and rolling requirements. Monitor furnace efficiency, fuel consumption, scale formation, and oxidation losses. Coordinate furnace discharge with rolling mill speed to minimize production interruptions. Take corrective action to prevent underheating, overheating, and unnecessary material wastage. Rolling Pass Schedule, Roll & Guide Setting Ensure correct pass schedule, roll groove selection, roll gap, and guide alignment for different product sizes. Supervise roll and guide setting, roll changes, size changeovers, and trial production. Maintain proper coordination between roughing, intermediate, and finishing stands. Troubleshoot cobbles, misrolling, bar twisting, guide failure, roll damage, and dimensional variations. Reduce changeover time, startup losses, rolling defects, and production downtime. Product Quality Control Ensure finished MS Rod / Deformed Bar meets approved specifications and applicable BSTI / BDS or other required standards. Monitor bar diameter, unit weight, length, rib pattern, surface finish, and dimensional accuracy. Coordinate with the Quality Control / Laboratory team for product inspection and required mechanical tests. Identify and resolve defects such as cracks, laps, seams, excessive scale, and inconsistent rib patterns. Ensure proper sampling, batch identification, traceability, and quality approval before finished product release. Production Yield & Cost Optimization Monitor billet consumption, finished output, rolling yield, scale loss, crop loss, cobble loss, cutting loss, and rejection. Analyze production efficiency and implement measures to reduce material wastage and improve yield. Monitor electricity consumption, furnace fuel, roll consumption, lubricants, and other production expenses. Control production cost per ton while maintaining required product quality. Prepare production and material reconciliation reports and investigate abnormal losses. Machinery Maintenance & Downtime Control Coordinate with Mechanical, Electrical, and Maintenance teams for preventive and breakdown maintenance. Monitor rolling stands, rolls, bearings, motors, gearboxes, guides, shears, cooling beds, and related equipment. Identify recurring mechanical and electrical problems and ensure timely corrective action. Plan maintenance activities and roll changes to minimize production interruptions. Monitor equipment availability, breakdown time, and maintenance-related production losses. Cooling Bed, Cutting & Finished Product Handling Supervise cooling bed operation, bar alignment, cutting length, counting, bundling, tagging, and finished product handling. Ensure accurate bundle weight, piece count, product identification, and finished goods records. Prevent product mixing, handling damage, incorrect labeling, and avoidable cutting losses. Coordinate with Quality Control, Store, and Logistics teams for finished goods storage and dispatch readiness. Manpower & Shift Management Supervise rolling mill shift in-charges, furnace operators, rolling operators, technicians, supervisors, and production workers. Allocate manpower according to production requirements and prepare shift schedules. Monitor attendance, discipline, productivity, and operational performance. Provide technical guidance and on-the-job training to improve production efficiency. Ensure proper shift handover and accountability for production, quality, and equipment condition. Production Reporting & Continuous Improvement Prepare daily, shift-wise, weekly, and monthly reports covering production output, billet consumption, yield, rejection, downtime, and energy consumption. Monitor KPIs such as production per shift, yield percentage, rejection rate, mill availability, and cost per ton. Maintain accurate production records using MS Excel, ERP software, or other factory management systems. Identify production bottlenecks and implement corrective and preventive actions. Recommend process improvements to increase production capacity, reduce wastage, and maintain consistent product quality.
